newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket-Spinner Adams strikes crucial blow vs India.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Spinner Adams strikes crucial blow vs India.

text.p: Rookie South African bowler Paul Adams, playing in only his third test, dealt a crucial blow to India on Wednesday, grabbing the wicket of opener Sanjay Manjrekar on the opening day of the first test.
At lunch, India -- electing to bat after winning the toss -- were 63 runs for two wickets.

Adams, a left arm spinner who joined the tourists only on Tuesday missing a series of one-day games in the early part of the tour, bowled Manjrekar in his fourth over for a well-compiled 34 including four boundaries.

Earlier Manjrekar and Rahul Dravid looked like taking India out of trouble after the home side lost opener Nayan Mongia for nine with the total at 22. Mongia was adjudged leg before wicket off paceman Fannie De Villiers.
Captain Sachin Tendulkar was batting with Dravid (18 not out) at the interval.
For India, batsman V.V.S. Laxman made his debut while the visitors brought in Adams.
Scores: India 63 for two at lunch (S. Manjrekar 34)
